_about: Which graphic on which hand-filled onboarding describes which InkSoft art file (M-14). build-profiles.mjs parses each note with the form's own parseNoteToForm and stores that graphic as the profile. Art names are InkSoft's DesignName WITHOUT the '-100044' style suffix InkSoft adds to a per-garment-colour copy. 'colors' = the garment colours that onboarding covered: a profile is only trusted for those (a white shirt is not a navy shirt with the same ink). Newest source wins for the same color set; an art described for different color sets keeps each as a variant (E-79).

products._about: Store-level answers per form product, from the same onboardings.
